usedFor: Product hunt is the source for launches, and “When a new product is posted” can create a HubSpot deal.

bestTemplate.name: “When a product becomes hot” in Product hunt, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Only products gaining enough votes to turn hot become deals, so the pipeline stays short.

watchOut: Every Product Hunt trigger here is polling, so a featured product reaches HubSpot after a short delay.
